alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 7 at 11:47AM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures ranging
from the mid 80s to mid 90s. Nights will be very warm with low
temperatures in the upper 60s to low 70s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
